import os
import sys
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from lightgbm import LGBMClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
from tqdm import tqdm

# Disable warnings and progress bars to avoid clutter and potential timeouts
os.environ["OMP_NUM_THREADS"] = "1"
if hasattr(pd.core.config.option, "options"):
    pd.options.mode.chained_assignment = None

# Paths defined in task
TRAIN_PATH = "./input/train.csv"
TEST_PATH = "./input/test.csv"
SAMPLE_SUBMIT_PATH = "./input/sample_submission.csv"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
SUBMISSION_FILE = f"{SUBMISSION_DIR}/submission.csv"

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# Load data
df_train = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
df_test = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)
df_sample = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_SUBMIT_PATH)

# Identify columns
target_col = "Cover_Type"
id_col = "Id"

# Prepare features
features_cols = [c for c in df_train.columns if c != id_col and c != target_col]

# Extract features and targets
X_train = df_train[features_cols].values.astype(float)
y_train = df_train[target_col].astype("int").values

X_test = df_test[features_cols].values.astype(float)
# Test IDs for submission
test_ids = df_test[id_col].values

# Split training data for validation (Hold-out)
X_train_full, X_val, y_train_full, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Define Model
params = {
    "objective": "multiclass",
    "num_class": len(np.unique(y_train_full)),
    "metric": "accuracy",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "min_child_samples": 20,
    "feature_fraction": 0.9,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "scale_pos_weight": 1.0,
    "verbose": -1,
}

model = LGBMClassifier(**params)

# Train on training split only
try:
    model.fit(X_train_full, y_train_full, eval_set=(X_val, y_val))
except Exception as e:
    raise e

# Evaluate on validation set (Hold-out score)
y_val_pred = model.predict(X_val)
val_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val, y_val_pred)
print(f"Hold-out Validation Accuracy: {val_accuracy:.4f}")

# Predict on full test set
y_test_pred = model.predict(X_test)

# Prepare Submission
submission_df = pd.DataFrame({"Id": test_ids, "Cover_Type": y_test_pred})
submission_df.to_csv(SUBMISSION_FILE, index=False)

print("Submission saved to:", SUBMISSION_FILE)
